subject.title: [优化建议] 添加结构化错误处理和智能重试机制

question: Which installer npm failures should OpenClaw auto-retry or auto-repair, and where should it only print remediation guidance?
rationale: Source inspection shows a real diagnostics gap, but retrying transient network failures, repairing npm prefixes, and handling certificate failures can change install semantics and trust boundaries for existing users.

options.title: Define a narrow policy, then implement
options.body: Classify known npm failures, retry only idempotent transient network failures, and add platform-specific EACCES/TLS guidance or repair with focused Bash and PowerShell tests.

options.title: Guidance-only diagnostics
options.body: Keep install behavior mostly unchanged but add clearer EACCES, ENOSPC, EBADENGINE, network, and TLS messages with exact recovery docs or commands.

options.title: Keep current partial diagnostics
options.body: Accept the current npm code/syscall/errno output and targeted cleanup retries without a broader installer error policy.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow policy, then implement
recommendation.body: Classify known npm failures, retry only idempotent transient network failures, and add platform-specific EACCES/TLS guidance or repair with focused Bash and PowerShell tests.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest current history across the Bash, PowerShell, and Docker installer paths implicated by the decision.
